text:
Elena: Quick question for the Prague offsite crew  packing shoes debate: do you bring 2 pairs (casual + dress) or try to do 1 pair thats versatile? Also: any suggestions for quick laundry in hotel sinks?

Raj: I do 2 pairs if I'm presenting. One lightweight sneaker + one nicer shoe thats still comfy. For sink laundry, use a travel laundry soap sheet or a bit of shampoo, soak 30m, rub, rinse, roll in a towel to wring.

Marta: If you want to pack light, go with one pair of comfortable shoes and a pair of lightweight foldable flats in case you need something smart. Also packing cubes save so much space.

travel-bot: hotel-laundry-tip: use a sink stopper or bring a small collapsible basin. Quick-dry items (merino, nylon) work best. Avoid heavy cottons for sink washing.

Sam: Pro tip: pack one outfit that layers well so you can mix a tee + blazer for meetings. Also bring a small bar of detergent and a couple of dryer sheets to cut static.

Elena: Awesome, thanks. Poll: reply "2pairs" if you bring two, "1pair" if you try to do one versatile pair, or "depends" if it depends on agenda. Ill decide tonight and book space in the luggage allowance sheet.
